title: Data Handling and Presentation
introduction: Data Handling and Presentation is developed as a reasoning journey in which learners notice Data Handling and Presentation, observation, reasoning, application, evidence. The Gurukul lesson moves from observation and representation to explanation, practice, checking and transfer. Learners are expected to show how they know, not only state an answer.
